Requests will actually take advantage of is the ability of `ssl.wrap_socket` to use a directory as its `ca_certs`, so it is a more direct test of the required functionality 2. Since `_ssl.sslwrap` is not part of the public API, it's possible (although unlikely) that it might be renamed or moved in future. It seems much better to use undocumented behavior of the public API than to use an (also undocumented) private API.
